dataset.name: UCI AI4I 2020 milling machine failures
dataset.description: 10,000 rows of milling-machine process data with a rare (3.4%) machine-failure label. Contains identifier columns and five failure-mode flags that leak the target; the Data Steward has to catch both.

checks.label: Time-series structure
checks.detail: no entity/time counter found: treated as independent rows

checks.label: Multicollinearity
checks.detail: 0 pairs with |r| >= 0.95; max VIF 5.3 (Torque [Nm]). Tree models tolerate this, so it is reported, not blocking.

checks.label: Distribution shift (KS test)
checks.detail: first half vs second half of rows: 1 of 10 features shift (Process temperature [K] (D=0.32))

checks.label: Class balance
checks.detail: minority class = 3.48% of rows; ranking metric switches to average precision and classes are weighted

decisions.outcome: UDI, Product ID: one unique value per row (row identifier)
the dataset ships an official holdout; it is never used for model selection
minority class below 10% -> rank by cross-validated average precision (ROC-AUC is optimistic when positives are rare)
minority class below 30% -> balanced class weights on every candidate
fixed search space: LightGBM, XGBoost, Random Forest, Linear baseline
TWF: target leakage: P(target=1 | TWF=1) = 100% over 35 rows
HDF: target leakage: P(target=1 | HDF=1) = 100% over 98 rows
PWF: target leakage: P(target=1 | PWF=1) = 100% over 75 rows
OSF: target leakage: P(target=1 | OSF=1) = 100% over 80 rows
LightGBM ranks first on cross-validated average_precision (higher is better): the numbers picked it, and the holdout was not consulted
alert threshold = the out-of-fold score that maximises F1
global importance from 3000 training rows; top driver: Torque [Nm] (23%)
native Tree-SHAP equals shap.TreeExplainer to within 0.0e+00 on 400 rows
champion logged to MLflow and registered as sentinel-ai4i (alias: champion)
versioned FastAPI service generated with the same features.py and Tree-SHAP code used in training
service reproduces the trained model's scores
drift monitor armed on 5 feature distributions (early-life window, 50 rows); retrain rule: any top-10 feature PSI >= 0.25
